title: Finite power image families and automorphism actions in linear groups
summary: Let $k/\mathbb{Q}$ be a finitely generated field extension. We characterize the subgroups $G\leq GL_n(k)$ for which the power images $P_m(G)=\{g^m:g\in G\}$ form a finite family: this holds precisely when $G=N\rtimes F$, where $F$ is finite and $N$ is a uniquely divisible subgroup consisting of unipotent matrices. The subgroup $N$ is canonical and fully invariant.For $e=\exp(G/N)$, we obtain $P_m(G)=P_{\gcd(m,e)}(G)$, exactly $τ(e)$ distinct power images, and least positive period $e$, where $τ(e)$ is the number of positive divisors of $e$.Over $\mathbb{Q}$, the group coincides with the full…
